The PKGBUILD fetches prebuilt binaries from the project's official GitHub releases page (https://github.com/vicrodh/qbz) for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures. The sources are correctly mapped to versioned release assets, and while the `sha256sums` are set to 'SKIP', this is a common and acceptable practice for binary packages in the AUR, especially when the maintainer cannot provide independently verified checksums. The build process does not involve compilation but rather installs the prebuilt binary, desktop file, icons, metadata, and license files into standard system locations under `$pkgdir`. All operations are confined to the package directory and follow standard packaging conventions.

There are no suspicious commands such as `curl | bash`, `eval`, or downloads from untrusted third-party domains. The package depends only on standard Qt6, audio, and utility libraries consistent with a desktop audio application. It also includes appropriate optdepends for optional audio backends. The use of `!strip` is reasonable for a binary package where stripping debug symbols might not be desired or could interfere with crash diagnostics. No network requests, file exfiltration, obfuscated code, or unexpected system modifications occur during packaging.

The maintainer installs third-party licenses and metadata in accordance with licensing obligations, and icon sizes are installed in standard Hicolor-compliant paths. Everything aligns with expected behavior for a binary AUR package wrapping a legitimate upstream release.
</details>
